query.text: 请帮我留意行进路线，出现需要避让或注意的情况时告诉我。
query.text_en: Please watch my route and tell me about situations requiring avoidance or attention.

annotation.text_zh: 前方人行道上有交通锥，请注意避让。
annotation.text_en: There are traffic cones on the sidewalk ahead. Please avoid them.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
